csv_project_name: AE for Expo Center Auditorium Arena & Ballfield Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Clay County is seeking qualifications from experienced and qualified architectural firms and/or engineering firms to provide professional design and project management services for the planned renovations and improvements to the existing Clay County Expo C enter Auditorium, Arena, and Ballfield. Clay County aims to renovate the existing space by improving the Expo Center Auditorium including, but not limited to, interior and exterior painting, HVAC repairs, roof repairs, kitchen upgrades, plumbing improvemen ts, signage, paving of the Expo parking lot, and the addition of indoor chair storage. The Arena and Ballfield improvements include, but are not limited to, construction of a new 200 square foot concessions/ announcer booth, installation of sound equipment , painting of grandstand bleachers, stair repairs/ replacements, addition of ADA compliant seating, concrete work within the arena, repair and staining of wood fencing, installation of ballfield fencing, and construction of a safety fence.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
